title: Trichoscopy Pattern Algorithm
subtitle: Dermoscopic clues for common hair-loss diagnoses

steps.prompt: Are follicular ostia absent with white scar-like areas?
Cicatricial alopecia: subtype by perifollicular scale, erythema, pustules
Does the combined clinical and trichoscopic pattern favor alopecia areata?
steps.detail: Yellow or black dots alone are nonspecific. Exclamation/tapered hairs support AA but must be interpreted alongside scale, broken shafts, distribution, and other diagnoses.

steps.prompt: Is hair shaft diameter diversity/miniaturization prominent?
Is there comma/corkscrew hair, broken hairs, or diffuse scale?
Tinea capitis / hair shaft infection workup
Nonspecific pattern: reassess differential; TE is not established by exclusion of these few signs
